text: Assumption: The initialization occurs at an early stage — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The initialization occurs at an early stage — is this correct?
norm: the initialization occurs at an early stage
assumption: The initialization occurs at an early stage.
rationale: The specification text does not define an exact calling time in the process cycle, but catching SIGTERM requires early registration before entering regular application operation.

original.rationale: Der Spezifikationstext definiert keinen exakten Aufrufzeitpunkt im Prozesszyklus, doch erfordert das Abfangen von SIGTERM eine frühzeitige Registrierung vor dem Eintritt in den regulären Anwendungsbetrieb.
